name: swiftForwards

versions.rationale: Tells whether a Swift declaration uses its own base name as another receiver's member. Alamofire's HTTPHeaders.startIndex returns headers.startIndex and sort() calls headers.sort: a rename by text rewrote those calls to Array, which an editor's rename leaves alone, so the members' content changed with their name and their uids were lost. Such members are no longer rename candidates.

docs:
Whether the declaration on lines `startLine`–`endLine` of `text` uses `base` as a member of something other than
itself, as `var startIndex: Int { headers.startIndex }` does. A rename by text would rewrite that use too, which an
editor's rename never does, since it is another type's member.
